tanggal merah.es: día festivo marcado en el calendario
tanggal merah.en: public holiday marked in the calendar

texto: The usual order is **tanggal + número + mes + año**: «tanggal lima belas Oktober dua ribu dua puluh enam». **Tanggal** is the date or day of the month; **hari** is the day of the week.
The names of the months are written with initial capital. **Bulan** means «month» and also «moon»; the context clarifies the meaning.

analisis: on the seventeenth day of the month

That's «tanggal lahir».
«Tanggal merah» does not describe the time.
First goes the number of the day and then the month.
«Agustus» means August.
«Tujuh belas» means seventeen.
It is the Indonesian name of August.
It means April.
